identity.title: [v0.92.1][TAIL-06.14][security] Require SSH recovery for public Spot Runtime

values.goal: Guarantee independent SSH recovery for the public Spot Runtime module.
values.required_outcome: Plan-time key and SSH-CIDR guards, recoverable example, negative Terraform tests, and explicitly approved bounded live proof with disposal.
authority_boundary: Operator authorized typed v2 exception after native card-validation failure.
Cloud apply requires separate explicit approval of concrete plan.
operator_constraints: Use approved Agent Logic business AWS profile.
Use one existing operator-approved key; never expose private key contents.
